title: Karnataka: Farmers may have to wait a year or more to grow new crop varieties of ragi, maize and  amaranth
description: These new varieties include Ragi GPU 101 which is an improved variety of MR-322, Maize MAH-20-45, an improved variety of MAH-14-5, and Grain Amaranth KBGA-18, an improved variety of KBGA-15.
